freezesBeforeCalculation.timing: Initial source/rights plan saved before requests; exact two-term source limitation, modal adapter and residual definitions saved before any thermal residual calculations.

resources.finding: Processed CMIP6 retains each original source's licensing restrictions; checking original model licenses, acknowledgements and retractions is mandatory. Processing citation: Nicholls et al., doi:10.1002/gdj3.113. No permission for a particular model supplied by this README.

FTmod uses exactly two q/d terms and midpoint impulse sampling at lag+0.5. This sibling is not the alpha1 fair_runner imported by the operative GWI. Its exact source is used only through hash-pinned AST extraction of FTmod; original source retained privately.

Explicitly requires individual NetCDF global license attributes and says its CC-BY-SA template is an example, not applicable to all output; some models use noncommercial terms. Thus it does not establish TaiESM1-specific permission.

boundedAcquisition.controlAcquisitionDecision: Stopped before the preselected first-lexicographic AS-RCEC/TaiESM1/piControl/r1i1p1f1 MAG download because exact source-specific terms remain unavailable. No model switch after seeing a filter outcome, no zero/synthetic controls, no claim that the example license grants permission.
boundedAcquisition.forcingAcquisitionDecision: Existing public LFS pointer identities are retained, but do not grant data rights. No underlying Chris forcing-ensemble object downloaded.

controlAdmission.interface: Original native MAG bytes, independently extracted annual World year/tas CSV bytes, separate rights-evidence bytes, and complete semantic source identity/license metadata; no undocumented MAG parser claimed.
controlAdmission.byteGates: Original/extraction/terms SHA-256 must match. Exact license text with matching approved license URI must occur in both original text and rights evidence, not merely caller assertions.
controlAdmission.licenseBoundary: Only exact CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0 or CC0-1.0 admitted by this local-derivative adapter; unknown/noncommercial/ambiguous templates rejected. This engineering gate does not independently authenticate external records or replace future citation/retraction/publication review.
controlAdmission.identity: Institution/model/experiment/member/grid/version/variable retained semantically, not upstream's path-depth-dependent institution extraction. Every identity component must occur as a path component.
controlAdmission.calendar: At least176 consecutive unique finite integer annual source years; no dropna compaction, interpolation or calendar stitching. Explicitly stricter than upstream dropna, to avoid falsely continuous source histories.
controlAdmission.slices: Exactly176 positions, step88, count=(N-88)//88, first50-position source offset; preserve original source-year bounds and positional identities. Reuse unchanged exact strict three-year/thirty-year variability filter.

thermalBridge.independentRecurrences: All three original q/d terms retained. Exact piecewise-constant boundary and annual-mean mode responses computed separately from the sibling's midpoint-sampled impulse recurrence.
thermalBridge.sourceReference: Each original mode passed through the exact two-term source FTmod with its second coefficient zero, then all three mode outputs summed by linearity. No original q/d term dropped, changed or fitted.
thermalBridge.supportedAdapter: FaIR2.2.4 step_temperature accepts a diagonal modal transition matrix exp(-1/d) and input q*(-expm1(-1/d)). Modal coordinates are explicitly NOT physical ocean-layer states.
thermalBridge.qualification: This verifies only the algebraic supported modal-step adapter. It is not an independent physical FaIR2.2.4 run, alpha1 emulation proof, GSAT-to-GMST conversion, or accepted GWI fingerprint generator.

realSourceDiagnosticInputs.forcingUnit: W m-2, actual annual p50 source1750-2025, all276 exact annual midpoint/bound coordinates
realSourceDiagnosticInputs.forcingRights: Already established CC-BY-4.0 actual-source release; no rights extrapolated to the separate forcing uncertainty ensemble
realSourceDiagnosticInputs.parameterDefinition: All28 named author configurations, three native q/d terms each; q K per W m-2, d years. Original source values unchanged.

componentClasses.GHG: 52 exact-pinned source gas components: CO2/CH4/N2O plus halogen species; complete membership retained in thermal-method-result.json

realSourceDiagnosticInputs.sourceMethodResponseUnit: degrees Celsius, unregressed modal response; NOT attributed human GMST
realSourceDiagnosticInputs.initialState: All modal diagnostic states zero at1750 boundary, no baseline/natural-forcing rezeroing or target offsets. Original alpha1 initialization remains unverified.

actualNewResidualChecks.coverage: All28 original configurations × three actual p50 source classes, 276 years each; separate2015-2025 eleven-year window retained without SSP substitution

supportedModalStepMinusIndependentExactB.interpretation: Exact equality for this shared discrete matrix update does not establish missing alpha1 forcing-timing equivalence.

actualNewResidualChecks.precision: Digits record deterministic numerical residuals, not climate accuracy or a new scientific acceptance threshold.

scientificDecision.forcingDependency: Actual p50 history assembled into complete source classes for a deterministic method check only; independent actual GHG/OHF/Nat uncertainty ensembles with specific rights remain unfetched.
scientificDecision.nativeBoundaryDependency: Complete boundary-reconciled actual native emissions through2025 remains unmet; no forcing-to-emissions inversion or SSP-as-historical relabelling.
